evidence.quote: Go to studio.reducto.ai and sign up for a free account.
This opens an OAuth device-code flow in your browser. Once approved, your API key is saved to ~/.reducto/config.yaml
The hosted server runs at https://mcp.reducto.ai/mcp
In the Studio sidebar, click API Keys, then Create API Key. Give it a name and copy the key.

result.notes: Self-serve free signup at studio.reducto.ai gives immediate API key; REST API with bearer-token auth covers parse/extract/split/edit/classify document workflows (~16 endpoint paths, small surface). Credit-based free tier exists but exact free-credit limits aren't documented on the fetched pages. Official Reducto-published MCP server (reductoai/mcp-server-reducto) hosted at mcp.reducto.ai, supporting both static API-key bearer auth and an OAuth device-code login flow for local config.
result.one_liner: Reducto is a document parsing/extraction API that converts PDFs and other documents into structured, LLM-ready data (parse, extract, split, edit, classify).
